name: Sussex Turnpike under Route 10
alertText: Not safe to drive under Sussex Turnpike right now. Heavy rain has flooded this spot before.
source: Randolph Township Engineer / OEM Director, confirmed via email
note: About once a year a car is totaled after attempting to cross the high water here.

name: Route 10 westbound, Center Grove Rd to Jennifer Ave
alertText: Route 10 westbound near Center Grove Road may be flooded. Consider an alternate route.
source: Randolph Township Engineer / OEM Director, confirmed via email

name: Franklin Road, east of Rockaway Rd to Denville border
alertText: Franklin Road near the Denville border may be flooded due to sustained rain and upstream dam releases.
source: Randolph Township Engineer / OEM Director, confirmed via email
note: Flooding here is tied to prolonged rain events and upstream dam releases in the Rockaway River basin, not a simple rainfall-rate threshold.
